**Closed as not planned** · 2026-11-12T06:12Z

The HotCRM maintainer set this aside minutes after it was filed. Verbatim, 2026-11-12: 「平台现在没法按岗位决定谁看到哪个应用、默认进哪个应用（isDefault 是全局的）。暂时不考虑」.

hotcrm#2417 drops the matching acceptance line. Every position lands on the launcher home. The readings above stay here for whoever reopens it.

**Reopened and narrowed** · 2026-11-12T06:14Z

The maintainer corrected the message quoted in the close above. Verbatim, 2026-11-12: 「平台现在没法按岗位决定谁看到哪个应用（需要）、默认进哪个应用（isDefault 是全局的）（暂时不考虑）」. Who sees which app is **needed**, at p1. The per-position default app is set aside. The title and body above are narrowed to app visibility, and the default-app rows are marked out of scope.

**Closed as not planned: 18.3.0 already does this** · 2026-11-12T06:18Z

The hotcrm#2417 thread re-measured on 18.3.0 ([hotcrm#2417 comment 6816277907](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/issues/2417#issuecomment-6816277907)):
- A permission set's `tabPermissions` with `{ <app>: 'hidden' }` drops the app from `/me/apps` and from the launcher. The URL still opens.
- An app's `requiredPermissions`, plus a `systemPermissions` grant, is a hard gate.

Per-position app visibility is therefore HotCRM's own configuration, and the M10 row above was HotCRM not yet using it. The per-position default app stays set aside by the maintainer. Nothing is left for the platform on this card.
